About

Over the last couple of years I've managed social media and written content for small e-commerce and property businesses in Sri Lanka — most recently Fochant.lk, a dropshipping and reselling platform, where I write the post copy and video concepts behind their campaigns. I've also run accounts for a vehicle trading company and a land and estate business. Alongside this, I'm finishing a BSc in Computer Science on the joint IIT–University of Westminster programme, and a diploma in digital marketing and graphic design at Luxway Campus.

Good content earns the next second of someone's attention — that's the only metric that matters before any of the others.

capstone project · in development

Chapters 1–3 complete

AutoFin.lk

An AI-assisted vehicle and finance comparison platform built for the Sri Lankan market, where buyers currently have no single place to compare vehicle prices against financing options across companies. My supervisor is Mr. Yasiru Silva, and the research proposal is being written chapter by chapter — the build itself hasn't started yet.

Planned features: vehicle catalogue, multi-company finance comparison, an affordability calculator, an AI Affordability Coach, a Vehicle–Finance Matchmaker, a retrieval-grounded chatbot, and an admin panel. All AI components are being kept rule-based and explainable by design.

academic project · full-stack

NexusCare

A full-stack healthcare platform connecting patients, doctors, laboratories and pharmacies across one mobile app and four web portals. I was responsible for the complete backend and frontend of the laboratory portal, built with Flask and React, and helped design the MySQL schemas for the lab and pharmacy modules. Presented at the Hult Prize competition.

AquaMate

A fish-tank management system pairing a sensor device with a mobile app — real-time water parameter readings, live-streamed monitoring, chemical suggestions, a vet booking system and an open forum for fishkeepers. I worked on the team building this high-fidelity Figma prototype, informed by a 78-response survey of fish owners. Selected to present at IIT's Cutting Edge event.
